en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town. In the background stands a large historic castle-like building with a central tower and red roofs on a hill above the riverbank. Boats and small wooden barges lie along the shore and on the water in the foreground, with people sitting in one of the boats. Trees line the left side, and a bridge over the river is visible in the distance to the right. The sky is softly colored from yellow to blue. Red printed text at the top reads "Torgau." on the left and "Blick von der Elbe." on the right.
